name: Shoe Repair Shop
place: A traditional cobbler shoe repair workshop
speaker: Cobbler

tasks.goal: Greet the cobbler and state your purpose
tasks.hint: State your main purpose clearly upon arrival.
tasks.done_when: Learner greeted the cobbler and stated purpose.

Japanese.goal: 靴職人にあいさつして来店の目的を伝える
Japanese.hint: 来店したら、まず用件をはっきり伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Present worn leather boots for heel cobbler repair and re-soling
tasks.hint: Explain needed shoe repair to cobbler.
tasks.done_when: Learner presented leather boots for heel re-soling repair.

Japanese.goal: すり減った革のブーツを見せて、かかとの修理と靴底の張り替えを頼む
Japanese.hint: どんな修理が必要か、靴職人に説明しましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about price difference between rubber and leather replacement soles
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler to compare sole materials.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about rubber vs leather replacement soles price.

Japanese.goal: ゴム底と革底の張り替え料金の違いについて尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 靴底の素材ごとの違いを比べてもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if leather conditioning and waterproof polishing are included
tasks.hint: Inquire about shoe shine maintenance.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if leather polishing is included.
tasks.scene_hint: Aroma of leather polish and adhesive mixes with whirring sanding wheel sound.

Japanese.goal: 革の保湿ケアと防水磨きが料金に含まれるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 靴磨きなどのお手入れについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask how many days shoe repair work will take to complete
tasks.hint: Inquire about pickup schedule.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about shoe repair turnaround time.

Japanese.goal: 靴の修理に何日かかるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: いつ受け取れるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'reinforcement'
tasks.hint: Reinforcement is the action or process of strengthening or reinforcing something. Ask if boot sole edges need leather reinforcement.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'reinforcement'.

Japanese.goal: 「補強」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 「補強」は、物を丈夫にすることです。ブーツの靴底の縁に革の補強が必要か聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about stretching tight leather shoes for wider foot fit
tasks.hint: Ask if shoes can be expanded.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about stretching tight leather shoes.

Japanese.goal: きつい革靴を足幅に合わせて広げられるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 靴を伸ばして大きくできるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate discount for repairing three pairs of shoes together
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler for bulk repair discount.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated multi-pair shoe repair discount.

Japanese.goal: 靴三足をまとめて修理する割引を交渉する
Japanese.hint: まとめて頼むと割引になるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if broken zipper on leather jacket can be replaced here
tasks.hint: Inquire about non-footwear leather repair.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about zipper replacement on leather jacket.

Japanese.goal: 革ジャケットの壊れたファスナーをここで交換できるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 靴以外の革製品も修理できるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Politely point out loose stitching near boot heel during inspection
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler to reinforce stitching.
tasks.done_when: Learner pointed out loose heel stitching for repair.
tasks.scene_hint: Heavy iron shoe lasts and leather cutting knives rest on sturdy workbench.

Japanese.goal: 点検中に、ブーツのかかと付近の縫い目のほつれを丁寧に指摘する
Japanese.hint: 縫い目を補強してもらうよう頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if replacement shoelaces and cedar shoe trees are sold
tasks.hint: Inquire about shoe care accessories.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about buying shoelaces and cedar shoe trees.

Japanese.goal: 替えの靴ひもと杉材のシューツリーを売っているか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 靴のお手入れ用品について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm total repair cost and deposit requirements at drop-off
tasks.hint: Verify pricing details with cobbler.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed shoe repair pricing and deposit.

Japanese.goal: 預ける時に修理代の合計と前金が必要かを確認する
Japanese.hint: 料金の詳細を靴職人に確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Request paper claim ticket receipt with itemized repair descriptions
tasks.hint: Ask for pickup receipt ticket.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested paper claim ticket receipt.

Japanese.goal: 修理内容が項目ごとに書かれた紙の預かり票を頼む
Japanese.hint: 受け取り用の預かり票をもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Verify shop opening hours for picking up repaired boots
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler when shop opens for pickup.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified shop hours for item pickup.

Japanese.goal: 修理したブーツを受け取るために店の営業時間を確認する
Japanese.hint: 受け取りに来られるよう、何時に開くか聞きましょう。

tasks.goal: Thank the cobbler and bid farewell
tasks.hint: Express gratitude and close the conversation.
tasks.done_when: Learner thanked the cobbler AND said goodbye.

Japanese.goal: 靴職人にお礼を言って別れのあいさつをする
Japanese.hint: 感謝の気持ちを伝えて、会話を終えましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'shoelace'
tasks.hint: A shoelace is a cord or string used for fastening a shoe. Ask for replacement shoelaces with sturdy tips.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'shoelace'.

Japanese.goal: 「靴ひも」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 「靴ひも」は靴を結ぶためのひもです。先が丈夫な替えの靴ひもを頼んでみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'durability'
tasks.hint: Durability refers to the ability to withstand wear, pressure, or damage. Inquire about the durability of the replacement shoe soles.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'durability'.

Japanese.goal: 「耐久性」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 「耐久性」は、使っても傷みにくい性質のことです。張り替える靴底の耐久性について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'insole'
tasks.hint: An insole is a removable sole fitted inside a shoe for warmth or comfort. Ask if supportive comfort insoles fit in repaired boots.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'insole'.

Japanese.goal: 「中敷き」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 「中敷き」は靴の中に敷く取り外しできる底のことです。修理したブーツに足を支える中敷きが入るか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Use the word 'upper'
tasks.hint: The upper is the part of a shoe or boot above the sole. Point out cracked stitching along the shoe upper.
tasks.done_when: Learner used the word 'upper'.

Japanese.goal: 「アッパー」という単語を使う
Japanese.hint: 「アッパー」は靴底より上の部分です。靴のアッパーの縫い目が割れていることを伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about restoring antique leather riding boots
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler about restoration options for vintage leather boots.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about restoring antique leather riding boots.
tasks.scene_hint: Whirring sanding belts hum softly beside rows of vintage wooden shoe lasts.

Japanese.goal: 年代物の革の乗馬ブーツを修復できるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 古い革ブーツの修復方法について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if cobbler can replace worn brass eyelets on work boots
tasks.hint: Inquire about replacing damaged shoe eyelets.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if cobbler can replace worn brass eyelets.
tasks.scene_hint: Jars of colored wax polishes and dye bottles line the wooden workbench shelf.

Japanese.goal: 作業用ブーツのすり減った真ちゅうのハトメを交換できるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 傷んだハトメの交換について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about protective rubber tap soles for delicate dress shoes
tasks.hint: Ask if thin rubber layers can protect leather soles.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about protective rubber tap soles for dress shoes.
tasks.scene_hint: Heavy iron shoe stretchers stand beside a foot-pedal leather sewing machine.

Japanese.goal: 繊細な革靴に保護用の薄いゴム（ハーフラバー）を貼れるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 薄いゴムを貼って革底を守れるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if boot heel tips can be quieted with sound-dampening rubber
tasks.hint: Inquire about quiet rubber heel cap replacements.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about sound-dampening rubber heel tips.
tasks.scene_hint: Racks of newly repaired leather boots and oxford shoes await customer pickup.

Japanese.goal: ブーツのかかとの音を防音ゴムで静かにできるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 音の静かなゴムのかかと（トップリフト）への交換について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about custom leather dye color matching for handbag strap
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler if handbag leather color can be matched.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about custom leather dye color matching for handbag strap.
tasks.scene_hint: Polished brass rivets and eyelet punch tools sit neatly inside wooden drawers.

Japanese.goal: ハンドバッグの持ち手の革を元の色に合わせて染められるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: バッグの革の色を合わせられるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask about applying water-repellent wax treatment to suede boots
tasks.hint: Inquire about waterproofing options for suede material.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about applying water-repellent wax to suede boots.
tasks.scene_hint: Smell of rich saddle soap and pine resin fills the sunlit cobbler shop.

Japanese.goal: スエードのブーツに撥水ワックス加工ができるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: スエード素材の防水方法について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire if worn inner heel linings can be patched with soft leather
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler to repair interior heel friction tears.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if worn inner heel linings can be patched with leather.
tasks.scene_hint: Heavy leather aprons hang from hooks beside hanging rows of replacement soles.

Japanese.goal: すり切れたかかとの内側の裏地を柔らかい革で補修できるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: かかと内側の擦れによる破れを直してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask cobbler about fixing a split seam along a leather belt
tasks.hint: Inquire about leather belt seam stitching repair.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about fixing a split seam on a leather belt.
tasks.scene_hint: Strips of vegetable-tanned leather hang near the cutting bench under bright lamps.

Japanese.goal: 革ベルトの縫い目のほつれを直せるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 革ベルトの縫い直しについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about installing metal toe plates on leather tap dancing shoes
tasks.hint: Ask if metal taps can be screwed into shoe toes.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about installing metal toe plates on tap shoes.
tasks.scene_hint: Shiny chrome shoe horns and brass buckles sit inside countertop display cases.

Japanese.goal: タップダンス用の革靴のつま先に金属のプレートを付けられるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: つま先に金属のタップをねじで留められるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if cobbler can re-attach loose rubber soles on hiking boots
tasks.hint: Inquire about heavy-duty sole re-gluing service.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if loose rubber soles on hiking boots can be re-attached.
tasks.scene_hint: Rows of rubber lug sole replacements rest on lower storage shelves.

Japanese.goal: 登山靴のはがれかけたゴム底を付け直せるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 丈夫な接着での靴底の付け直しについて聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about replacing broken zipper pull on leather motorcycle jacket
tasks.hint: Ask if heavy brass zipper sliders can be replaced.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about replacing broken zipper pull on motorcycle jacket.
tasks.scene_hint: Heavy-duty brass zipper chains and slider pulls hang from rack pegs.

Japanese.goal: 革のバイク用ジャケットの壊れたファスナーの引き手を交換できるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 丈夫な真ちゅうのファスナーのスライダーを交換できるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Clarify if rubber tap soles can be glued directly over existing thin leather
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler to confirm glue adhesion on thin soles.
tasks.done_when: Learner clarified if rubber tap soles can be glued over existing soles.

Japanese.goal: 薄い革底の上に直接ゴムを貼れるかはっきりさせる
Japanese.hint: 薄い靴底でも接着がしっかりつくか確認しましょう。

tasks.goal: Report a loose eyelet discovered on hiking boot upper after repair
tasks.hint: Inform cobbler of unanchored metal eyelet on boot collar.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported loose eyelet discovered on hiking boot upper.

Japanese.goal: 修理後、登山靴のアッパーのハトメがゆるんでいるのを見つけて伝える
Japanese.hint: ブーツの履き口の金属のハトメが固定されていないことを伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about restoring faded suede boot color after water damage
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler if suede dye can restore original hue.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about restoring faded suede boot color.

Japanese.goal: 水濡れで色あせたスエードのブーツの色を戻せるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: スエード用の染料で元の色に戻せるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask cobbler to explain the difference between glued soles and stitched leather construction
tasks.hint: Inquire about sole stitching durability methods.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked cobbler to explain glued vs stitched sole construction.

Japanese.goal: 接着した靴底と縫い付けた革底の作りの違いを説明してもらう
Japanese.hint: 靴底の縫い方による耐久性の違いを聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Report uneven heel height wear noticed during boot try-on inspection
tasks.hint: Point out height imbalance between left and right heels.
tasks.done_when: Learner reported uneven heel height wear during boot inspection.

Japanese.goal: ブーツを試し履きして、かかとの高さが不揃いにすり減っていることを伝える
Japanese.hint: 左右のかかとの高さが違うことを指摘しましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if cobbler offers bulk discount when bringing four pairs of shoes
tasks.hint: Inquire about multi-pair repair pricing incentives.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if cobbler offers bulk discount for four pairs of shoes.

Japanese.goal: 靴を四足持ち込んだらまとめ割引があるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 複数の靴を修理する場合の割引について聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Confirm if waterproofing oil application will darken light tan leather
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler about color darkening effects of mink oil.
tasks.done_when: Learner confirmed if waterproofing oil darkens light tan leather.

Japanese.goal: 防水オイルを塗ると明るいタンの革が暗くなるか確認する
Japanese.hint: ミンクオイルで色が濃くなるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Request advice on oiling dry cracking leather boot uppers
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler how to nourish aged leather fibers.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested advice on oiling dry cracking leather uppers.

Japanese.goal: 乾いてひび割れたブーツのアッパーに油を入れる方法についてアドバイスを頼む
Japanese.hint: 古くなった革に栄養を与える方法を聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if cobbler can hold repaired boots in storage until next month
tasks.hint: Inquire about extended pickup storage policy.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if cobbler can hold repaired boots until next month.

Japanese.goal: 修理したブーツを来月まで預かってもらえるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 長期間の預かりについての決まりを聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Politely decline optional leather shine polishing service add-on
tasks.hint: Inform cobbler you only require basic sole replacement.
tasks.done_when: Learner declined optional leather shine polishing service add-on.

Japanese.goal: オプションの靴磨きサービスを丁寧に断る
Japanese.hint: 靴底の張り替えだけで十分だと伝えましょう。

tasks.goal: Ask if extra lace speed hooks can be installed on work boot collar
tasks.hint: Inquire about adding metal speed hooks to top eyelets.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked if extra lace speed hooks can be installed on work boots.

Japanese.goal: 作業用ブーツの履き口にフックを追加で付けられるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 上のハトメに金属のフックを付けられるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Verify claim ticket registration number details before leaving shop
tasks.hint: Check receipt number matches tag on dropped-off boots.
tasks.done_when: Learner verified claim ticket registration number details.

Japanese.goal: 店を出る前に預かり票の番号を確認する
Japanese.hint: 預かり票の番号が預けたブーツの札と同じか確かめましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about shelf life and care instructions for leather balsam wax
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler how often to reapply leather conditioning wax.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about shelf life and application frequency of leather balsam.

Japanese.goal: 革用バーム（ワックス）の使用期限とお手入れ方法について尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 保湿用ワックスをどのくらいの頻度で塗り直すか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate custom package price for resoling three pairs of leather work boots
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler for volume rate on multiple shoe sole repairs.
tasks.done_when: Learner negotiated package price for resoling three pairs of work boots.

Japanese.goal: 革の作業用ブーツ三足の靴底張り替えのセット料金を交渉する
Japanese.hint: 複数の靴底修理をまとめた料金にしてもらえるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Resolve issue where shoe stretching widened heel cup instead of toe box
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler to correct reshaped heel fitting.
tasks.done_when: Learner resolved issue where shoe stretching widened wrong boot section.

Japanese.goal: 靴を伸ばしたら、つま先ではなくかかとが広がってしまった問題を解決する
Japanese.hint: かかとの形を直してもらうよう頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Request detailed cost estimate for full structural restoration of vintage riding boots
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler for itemized breakdown before approving major repair work.
tasks.done_when: Learner requested detailed cost estimate for vintage riding boot restoration.

Japanese.goal: 年代物の乗馬ブーツを全面修復する場合の詳しい見積もりを頼む
Japanese.hint: 大がかりな修理を決める前に、項目ごとの内訳を出してもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Evaluate leather stiffness and collar padding to prevent ankle blisters
tasks.hint: Discuss leather softening options with cobbler.
tasks.done_when: Learner evaluated boot leather stiffness to prevent ankle chafing.

Japanese.goal: 足首の靴ずれを防ぐため、革の硬さと履き口のクッションを確かめる
Japanese.hint: 革を柔らかくする方法について靴職人と相談しましょう。

tasks.goal: Inquire about replacing broken briefcase handles with hand-stitched leather straps
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler about custom leather strap fabrication.
tasks.done_when: Learner asked about replacing broken briefcase handles with hand-stitched leather.

Japanese.goal: 壊れたブリーフケースの持ち手を手縫いの革ベルトに交換できるか尋ねる
Japanese.hint: 革の持ち手をオーダーで作れるか聞いてみましょう。

tasks.goal: Address situation where replacement heel rubber color does not match original leather
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler to swap heel cap for matching dark brown rubber.
tasks.done_when: Learner addressed mismatch in replacement heel rubber color.

Japanese.goal: 交換したかかとのゴムの色が元の革と合わない問題に対応する
Japanese.hint: こげ茶色のゴムに付け替えてもらうよう頼みましょう。

tasks.goal: Compare longevity of Vibram rubber soles versus traditional oak-bark leather soles
tasks.hint: Ask cobbler to contrast durability and traction of sole materials.
tasks.done_when: Learner compared Vibram rubber soles versus oak-bark leather soles.

Japanese.goal: ビブラムのゴム底と昔ながらのオークバーク（植物なめし）の革底の長持ち度を比べる
Japanese.hint: 靴底の素材ごとの耐久性とすべりにくさを比べてもらいましょう。

tasks.goal: Negotiate rush overnight repair service fee for emergency wedding footwear

Japanese.goal: 結婚式で急いで必要な靴の翌日仕上げの特急料金を交渉する

tasks.goal: Inquire about fitting custom supportive arch insoles into narrow dress shoes

tasks.goal: Ask cobbler for structural evaluation of worn heel cushions upon entering

Japanese.goal: 店に入ってすぐ、すり減ったかかとの状態を見てもらう

tasks.goal: Inquire if shop provides repair services for leather travel bags and belts

tasks.goal: State intention to drop off work boots for resoling before winter season

tasks.goal: Inspect newly stitched sole craftsmanship before leaving cobbler workbench

tasks.done_when: Learner inspected newly stitched sole craftsmanship before leaving.

Japanese.goal: 帰る前に新しく縫った靴底の仕上がりを確かめる

tasks.goal: Confirm pickup date and estimated turnaround time on paper repair ticket

tasks.goal: Verify whether cash or card payment is preferred for repair deposit
